TRUMP INTERNATIONAL HOTEL & TOWER DUBAI
DUBAI | UAE
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit. Completion is scheduled for December 2031.

CHALLENGE EVERYTHING. STOP AT NOTHING.
Step inside. Look around. This is what winning looks like. Residences & penthouses with soaring ceilings and bespoke finishes. Every inch, a statement of dominance. Overlook the shimmering skyline, the grandeur of Burj Khalifa or the limitless sea. These are the headquarters for the ambitions of visionaries, disruptors, and game-changers. And you’re next.

KEY FEATURES
The Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai brings together three iconic worlds in one address: a five-star hotel, a members-only club, and private residences, each with its own state-of-the-art amenities.
Trump International Hotel & Tower
A five-star luxury hotel, joining the legacy of Trump organization most iconic hotels. Featuring fine dining, world-class entertainment, and true luxury at every turn.
The Trump, Members-Only Club
The Trump Members-Only Club brings together wellness, business, and the timeless atmosphere of a classic private club. Access is limited to members only through an annual fee, with residents receiving priority access.
The Trump Residences
Featuring 1, 2, & 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses, the residences dominate the skyline — with every unit offering a view. Residents also enjoy exclusive access to the highest outdoor pool in the world.
AMENITIES OF THE TRUMP RESIDENCES

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.
When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.
Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.
Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.
What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, developed by DarGlobal. The Astera offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beachfront villas ranging from 61 to 265 sqm. All units feature Aston Martin-designed interiors and sit on Al Marjan Island with direct beach access.

Aston Martin's design team was responsible for the interiors of every residence, applying the brand's approach to precision, material quality, and artisanal craftsmanship to kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The Astera is on Al Marjan Island, a man-made island off the Ras Al Khaimah coastline, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport. It sits approximately 5 minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East.
What amenities does The Astera offer?
Amenities include direct beach access, an infinity pool, spa, sauna, pool bar, fitness centre, indoor cinema, yoga lawn, multipurpose hall, children's play area, and premium 24/7 security. Beach villas offer private access to the shoreline directly from the residence.

DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, is marking its fifth anniversary following a period of rapid international expansion that has transformed the company into a USD 23 billion global real estate platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities.

This milestone reflects our confidence in Saudi Arabia’s vibrant real estate market and our mission to deliver globally benchmarked developments that elevate the local landscape.”

Rasheed Mikati, Executive Director of Arabian Construction Company, added: “We are immensely proud to be awarded this significant contract for Trump Tower Jeddah. This collaboration with DarGlobal reinforces our proven expertise in delivering complex, high-profile projects. DarGlobal consistently delivers world-class projects, and we are thrilled to partner with them on this iconic development. ACC is fully committed to bringing this architectural landmark to life with the highest standards of quality and innovation, ensuring it becomes a testament to Jeddah’s ambition and our capabilities.

DarGlobal Rings the London Stock Exchange Opening Bell, Anchoring Global Expansion with Launch of “Live All In” Slogan

18/11/2025
London, United Kingdom

DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, today marked a pivotal moment by ringing the market opening bell at the London Stock Exchange (LSE). This ceremony not only celebrated its recent transfer to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category but also hailed a historic achievement. DarGlobal being the first-ever Saudi-born company, and the first from the wider Middle East, to complete such a transition on the LSE’s Main Market.

Coinciding with this milestone, DarGlobal also unveiled its powerful new brand slogan, ‘Live All In’. This philosophy embodies a bold way of life, crafted for DarGlobal's global network of discerning buyers, investors, and partners. Built on a legacy of over 31 years of integrity, DarGlobal’s ‘Live All In’ invites discerning individuals to experience luxury without compromise, invest with confidence, and be part of a future where global aspirations meet tangible opportunities.

Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal, commented from the LSE: "Today is a momentous occasion, symbolizing both our deep commitment to global capital markets and the audacious spirit that defines DarGlobal. London’s sophisticated capital markets offer unparalleled visibility, credibility, and adherence to international governance standards. As we mark these achievements, we proudly launch 'Live All In' – a philosophy that encapsulates our unwavering dedication to excellence and our unique approach to creating unparalleled lifestyle experiences and investment pathways across the globe. With DarGlobal, you are global, you are our greatest ambassador, and your future is secure; and when these three come together, the result is simple: happiness. This is what ‘Live All In’ stands for."

‘Live All In’ signifies DarGlobal's relentless pursuit of distinctive experiences, bold decisions, and lasting value. This philosophy underpins a period of unprecedented expansion, with Gross Development Value (GDV) surging to US$19 billion, driven by recent major joint development agreements and strategic land acquisitions in Riyadh and Jeddah.

These ambitious growth trajectories and the ‘Live All In’ slogan are significantly propelled by DarGlobal's strategic alliances. DarGlobal has partnered with over 10 world-renowned luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, Fendi, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Pagani Automobili, and W Hotels. These collaborations offer unique investment opportunities in global cities, providing both wealth growth and protection. Concurrently, collaborations with financial advisory leaders like Rothschild & Co and strategic consultants like AlixPartners are accelerating global expansion, including a planned entry into the competitive US market.

Complementing this momentum, DarGlobal is expanding into financial services and asset management through a newly established investment arm designed to give international investors structured access to its global development pipeline. By pairing its real estate expertise with regulated investment capabilities, the company is shaping an integrated platform that connects global capital with the next wave of opportunities emerging across Saudi Arabia and international gateway cities.

As the first Saudi company to list on the London Stock Exchange's Main Market, DarGlobal serves as a crucial bridge for international investors. The Kingdom's real estate market is undergoing a profound transformation, driven by Vision 2030 and landmark initiatives like the upcoming new law on foreign real estate ownership, set to take effect in January 2026. This pivotal legislation significantly opens the market, allowing non-Saudis to own property within designated zones and attracting substantial foreign capital. DarGlobal’s projects are at the forefront of this new era of luxury living, offering first-movers a chance to be part of the world's next great real estate story.
